## What works now

Describe the user-visible result and link the task, for example `Closes #2` only when its acceptance criteria are complete.

## Checks

State what you actually checked. Add a desktop/mobile screenshot for UI changes, an example response for API changes, or a sample input/output for AI work. Use fictional data.

## Handoff

Name any API/fixture changes, required environment variable names, and remaining limitations or simulations. Never include secret values.

Review by one other teammate before merging. Keep unrelated changes in a separate PR.
